arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا كَافِيَ الْفَرْدِ الضَعِيْفِ، وَوَاقِيَ الامْرِ الْمَخُوْفِ،
transliteration: allāhumma yā kāfīya al-fard al-ḍaʿīf, wa wāqiya al-amri al-makḥūf
english_text: O God, O Sufficer of the isolated and weak and Protector against terrifying affairs!

arabic_text: أَفْرَدَتْنِي الْخَـطَايَا; فَـلاَ صَاحِبَ مَعِي،
transliteration: afradatni al-khaṭāyā; falā ṣāḥiba maʿī
english_text: Offenses have isolated me, so there is none to be my companion.

arabic_text: وَضَعُفْتُ عَنْ غَضَبِكَ; فَلاَ مُؤَيِّدَ لِي،
transliteration: waḍaʿuftu ʿan ghaḍabika; falā muʾayyida lī
english_text: I am too weak for Thy wrath and there is none to strengthen me.

arabic_text: وَأَشْرَفْتُ عَلَى خَوْفِ لِقَائِكَ; فَلاَ مُسَكِّنَ لِرَوْعَتِي،
transliteration: wa-ashraftu ʿalaa khawfi liqa'ika; falaa musakkina li-rawʿati
english_text: I have approached the terror of meeting Thee and there is none to still my fear.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُنِي مِنْكَ وَأَنْتَ أَخَفْتَنِي؟
transliteration: wa-man yu'minuni mink(a) wa-anta akhafatni?
english_text: Who can make me secure from Thee when Thou hast filled me with terror?

arabic_text: وَمَن يساعِدُنِي وَأَنْتَ أَفْرَدْتَنِي؟
transliteration: wa-man yusā`idunī wa-anta afradtanī?
english_text: Who can come to my aid when Thou hast isolated me?

arabic_text: وَمَنْ يُقَوِّيْنِي وَأَنْتَ أَضْعَفْتَنِي؟
transliteration: wa-man yuqawwimni wa-anta ad'afatani?
english_text: Who can strengthen me when Thou hast weakened me?

arabic_text: لاَ يُجيرُ يا إلهي إلاّ رَبٌّ عَلَى مَرْبُوب، وَلاَ يُؤْمِنُ إلاّ غالِبٌ عَلَى مَغْلُوب، وَلاَ يُعِينُ إِلاّ طالِبٌ عَلَى مَطْلُوب،
transliteration: lā yujīru yā ilāhī illā rabbun ʿalā marbūb wa lā yuʾminu illā ghālibun ʿalā maghlūb wa lā yuʿīnu illā ṭālibun ʿalā maṭlūb
english_text: None can grant sanctuary to a vassal, my God, but a lord, none can give security to one dominated but a dominator, none can aid him from whom demands are made but a demander.

arabic_text: وَبِيَـدِكَ يَـاَ إلهِي جَمِيعُ ذلِكَ السَّبَبِ، وَإلَيْكَ الْمَفَرُّ وَالْمَهْربُ.
transliteration: wa biyadika ya ilahi jami'u dhalika al-sababi, wa ilaika al-mafarru wa al-mahrabu
english_text: In Thy hand, my God, is the thread of all that, in Thee the place of escape and flight,

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَجِرْ هَرَبِي وَأَنْجِحْ مَطْلَبِي.
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa-ajir harabī wa-anjih maṭlabī
english_text: so bless Muhammad and his Household, give sanctuary to me in my flight, and grant my request!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ إنْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيْمَ، أَوْ مَنَعْتَنِي فَضْلَكَ الْجَسِيمَ، أَوْ حَظَرْتَ عَلَيَّ رِزْقَكَ أَوْ قَطَعْتَ عَنِّي سَبَبَـكَ لَمْ أَجِدِ السَّبِيـلَ إلَى شَيْء مِنْ أَمَلِي غَيْرَكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka in saraf ta ʿannī wajhaka al- karīm 'aw manā'tanī faḍlaka al-jasīmā 'aw ḥaẓarta ʿalayya rizqaka 'aw qaṭaʿta ʿannī sababaka lam ajidi as-sabil ila shay'in min amalii ghayrak
english_text: O God, if Thou shouldst turn Thy generous face away from me, withhold from me Thy immense bounty, forbid me Thy provision, or cut off from me Thy thread, I will find no way to anything of my hope other than Thee

arabic_text: وَلَمْ أَقْدِرْ عَلَى مَا عِنْدَكَ بِمَعُونَةِ سِوَاكَ; فَإنِّي عَبْدُكَ، وَفِي قَبْضَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، لاَ أَمْرَ لِي مَعَ أَمْرِكَ،
transliteration: wa lam aqdir 'ala ma 'indaka bima'unati siwaka; fa-inni 'abduk wa fī qabḍatika nāṣiyatī biyadika, lā amra lī maʿa amrika
english_text: nor be given power over what is with Thee through another's aid, for I am Thy servant and in Thy grasp; my forelock is in Thy hand. I have no command along with Thy command.

arabic_text: مَاض فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَى الْخُـرُوجِ مِنْ سُلْطَانِـكَ، وَلاَ أَسْتَطِيـعُ مُجَاوَزَةَ قُدْرَتِكَ،
transliteration: māḍ fīyya ḥukmuka, ʿadlun fīyya qaḍāʾuka wa lā quwwata lī ʿalā al-khurūji min sultanika walā astaṭīʿu mujāwazata qudratika
english_text: 'Accomplished is Thy judgement of me, just Thy decree for me!' I have not the strength to emerge from Thy authority nor am I able to step outside Thy power.

arabic_text: وَلاَ أَسْتَـمِيلُ هَوَاكَ، وَلاَ أبْلُغُ رِضَاكَ، وَلاَ أَنَالُ مَا عِنْدَكَ إلاَّ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَبِفَضْل رَحْمَتِكَ.
transliteration: wa lā astamilu hawāka, walā ablughu riḍāka walā anālu mā ʿindaka illā biṭāʿatika wa bifadl raḥmatika
english_text: I cannot win Thy inclination, arrive at Thy good pleasure, or attain what is with Thee except through obeying Thee and through the bounty of Thy mercy.

arabic_text: إلهِي أَصْبَحْتُ وَأَمْسَيْتُ عَبْداً دَاخِراً لَكَ،
transliteration: ilāhī ʾaṣbaḥtu waʾamsaytu ʿabdān dākhiran laka
english_text: O God, I rise in the morning and enter into evening as Thy lowly slave.

arabic_text: لا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً إلاَّ بِكَ
transliteration: lā amliku li-nafsī nafʿan walā ḍarran illā bika
english_text: I own no profit and loss for myself except through Thee.

arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ بِذَلِكَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَأَعْتَـرِفُ بِضَعْفِ قُـوَّتِي وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
transliteration: ashhadu bi dhalika ʿala nafsi wa aʿtarifu bi ḍaʿfi quwwati wa qillati ḥiylati
english_text: I witness to that over myself and I confess to the frailty of my strength and the paucity of my stratagems.

arabic_text: فَأَنْجزْ لِي مَا وَعَدْتَنِي، وَتَمِّمْ لِي مَا آتَيْتَنِي; فَإنِّي عَبْـدُكَ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتكِينُ الضَّعِيفُ الضَّـرِيـرُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمَهِينُ الْفَقِيرُ الْخَائِفُ الْمُسْتَجِيرُ.
transliteration: fa'anjiẓ li mā waʿadtanī, wa tamimm li mā ʾātaytanī fa-in-ni ʿab-duka al-mis-ki-nu al-mus-ta-ki-nu al-ḍaʿ-īf al-ḍarīru al-ḏẓilil al-ḥaqīru al-mahīnu al-faqīru al-khāʾifu al-mustajīru
english_text: So accomplish what Thou hast promised me and complete for me what Thou hast given me, for I am Thy slave, miserable, abased, frail, distressed, vile, despised, poor, fearful, and seeking sanctuary!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي نَاسِيَاً لِذِكْرِكَ فِيمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي، وَلاَ غافِلاً لإحْسَانِكَ فِيمَا أَبْلَيْتَنِي، وَلا آيسَاً مِنْ إجَابَتِكَ لِي وَإنْ أَبْطَأتَ عَنِّي
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa lā tajʿalnī nāsiyāan li dhikrika fīmā aulaytanī walā ghāfilan li-iḥsānik fīmā ablaytanī wa lā ʾāysan min ʾijābatika lī wa-in ʾabṭaʾta ʿannī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and let me not forget to remember Thee in what Thou hast done for me, be heedless of Thy beneficence in Thy trying me, or despair of Thy response to me, though it keep me waiting,

arabic_text: فِي سَرَّاءَ كُنْتُ أَوْ ضَرَّاءَ، أَوْ شِدَّة أَوْ رَخَاء، أَوْ عَافِيَة أَوْ بَلاء، أَوْ بُؤْس أَوْ نَعْمَاءَ، أَوْ جِدَة أَوْ لأوَاءَ، أَوْ فَقْر أَوْ غِنىً.
transliteration: fī sarrāʾa kun tu aw ḍarrāʾa, aw shiddaẗin aw rakḥāʾ aw ʿafiyah aw balāʾ, aw buʾs aw naʿmāʾ aw jidah aw lawa', aw faqr aw ghinā
english_text: whether I be in prosperity or adversity, hardship or ease, well-being or affliction, misery or comfort, wealth or distress, poverty or riches!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ ثَنائِي عَلَيْكَ وَمَدْحِي إيَّاكَ وَحَمْدِي لَكَ فِي كُلِّ حَالاَتِي حَتَّى لاَ أَفْرَحَ بِمَا آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-jʿal thanā'i ʿalayka wa-madḥī iyyāka wa ḥamdī laka fī kulli ḥalātī ḥattá lā ʾafráḥa bimā ʾātaytanī mina al-dunyā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make me laud Thee, extol Thee, and praise Thee in all my states so that I rejoice not over what Thou givest me of this world

arabic_text: وَلاَ أَحْـزَنَ عَلَى مَا مَنَعْتَنِي فِيهَا،
transliteration: wa laa aḥzan ʿalaa maa manaʿtani fiiha
english_text: nor sorrow over that of it which Thou withholdest from me!

arabic_text: وَأَشْعِرْ قَلْبِي تَقْوَاكَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْ بَدَنِي فِيْمَا تَقْبَلُهُ مِنِّي، وَاشْغَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ نَفْسِي عَنْ كُلِّ مَايَرِدُ عَلَىَّ حَتَّى لاَ اُحِبَّ شَيْئَاً مِنْ سُخْطِكَ،
transliteration: wa ash'ir qalbi taqwaak waastaʿmil badanī fīmā taqbāluhu minnī wa ashghal bi taʿaatika nafsī ʿan kulli mā yaridu ʿalayya ḥattá lā uḥibba shayʾan min sukhṭika
english_text: Impart reverential fear of Thee to my heart, employ my body in that which Thou acceptest from me, and divert my soul through obedience to Thee from all that enters upon me, so that I love nothing that displeases Thee

arabic_text: وَلا أَسْخَطَ شَيْئـاً مِنْ رِضَـاكَ.
transliteration: wa lā askhata shay'an min riḍāka
english_text: and become displeased at nothing that pleases Thee!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَفَرِّغْ قَلْبِي لِمَحَبَّتِكَ ، وَاشْغَلْهُ بِذِكْرِكَ، وَانْعَشْهُ بِخَوْفِكَ ، وَبِالْوَجَلِ مِنْكَ، وَقَوِّهِ بِالرَّغْبَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَأَمِلْهُ إلَى طَاعَتِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa farriġ qalbi li-maḥabbatika, wa ashġalhu bi-dhikrika wa inʿashu bi khawfika, wa bil wajali minka wa qawwih bi-r-raghbah ilayka, wa amilhu ila ta'atika
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, empty my heart for Thy love, occupy it with remembering Thee, animate it with fear of Thee and quaking before Thee, strengthen it with beseeching Thee, incline it to Thy obedience,

arabic_text: وَأَجْرِ بِهِ فِي أَحَبِّ السُّبُلِ إلَيْكَ، وَذَلِّلْهُ بِالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ أَيَّامَ حَيَاتِي كُلِّهَا،
transliteration: wa ajri bihi fi ahabbi alssubuli ilayka wa dha(ll)ilhu bi-r-raqbah fima `indaka ayyama hayati kulliha
english_text: set it running in the path most beloved to Thee, and subdue it through desire for what is with Thee all the days of my life!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ تَقْوَاكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا زَادِي، وَإلَى رَحْمَتِكَ رِحْلَتِي، وَفِي مَرْضَاتِكَ مَدْخَلِي.
transliteration: wa-jaʿl taqwāka minad-dunyā zādī wa'ilā raḥmatika riḥlatī, wa fī marḍātika madkhalī
english_text: Let my provision in this world be reverential fear of Thee (ref. 2:197), my journey be toward Thy mercy, and my entrance be into Thy good pleasure!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ فِي جَنَّتِكَ مَثْوَايَ، وَهَبْ لِي قُوَّةً أَحْتَمِلُ بِهَا جَمِيعَ مَرْضَاتِكَ، وَاجْعَلْ فِرَارِي إلَيْكَ، وَرَغْبَتِي فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَأَلْبِسْ قَلْبِي الْوَحْشَةَ مِنْ شِرارِ خَلْقِكَ.
transliteration: wa-jaʿl fi jannatika mathwaya wa hab li quwwatan ahtamilu biha jami'a marzatika wa-jʿal firaari ʾilayka, wa-raghbatii fima ʿindak waalbis qalbi alwahshata min shiraar khalkika
english_text: Appoint for me a lodging in Thy Garden, give me strength to bear everything that pleases Thee, make me flee to Thee and desire what is with Thee, clothe my heart in estrangement from the evil among Thy creatures,

arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي الأُنْسَ بِكَ وَبِأَوْلِيَـآئِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa hab li al-uns bi-ka wa bi-awliyā'ika wa ahli ṭā'atika
english_text: and give me intimacy with Thee, Thy friends, and those who obey Thee!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ لِـفَاجِـر وَلا كَافِر عَلَيَّ مِنَّةً، وَلاَ لَـهُ عِنْدِي يَداً، وَلا بِي إلَيْهِمْ حَاجَةً،
transliteration: walā tajʿal li-fājirin walā kāfirin ʿalayya minnan wa lā lahu ʿindī yadun, wa lā bī ilayhim ḥājaẗan
english_text: Assign to no wicked person or unbeliever a kindness toward me or a hand that obliges me, nor to me a need for one of them!
